Chilton Investment Co Decreased Wayfair (W) Holding as Shares Declined; London Co Of Virginia Lifted Tiffany & Co New (TIF) Stake
May 16, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
London Co Of Virginia increased its stake in Tiffany & Co New (TIF) by 16.74% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. London Co Of Virginia bought 55,082 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.13% with the market. The institutional investor held 384,142 shares of the consumer specialties company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $39.93 million, up from 329,060 at the end of the previous reported quarter. London Co Of Virginia who had been investing in Tiffany & Co New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $12.94 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.00% or $2.04 during the last trading session, reaching $103.92. About 647,998 shares traded. Tiffany& Co. (NYSE:TIF) has risen 1.55% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.00% the S&P500.
Richard Chilton decreased its stake in Wayfair Inc (W) by 53.61% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Chilton Investment Co Llc sold 315,828 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.33% with the market. The hedge fund run by Richard Chilton held 273,269 shares of the catalog and specialty distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $21.94M, down from 589,097 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Chilton Investment Co Llc who had been investing in Wayfair Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $7.55B market cap company. The stock increased 0.20% or $0.17 during the last trading session, reaching $84.76. About 403,891 shares traded. Wayfair Inc. (NYSE:W) has risen 69.10% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 57.55% the S&P500.
